title: TrashCans issue #61: [1.1.1 NeoForge 26.1.2] Crash (NullPointerException) when an Item Trash Can writes its deleted items
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by alexhcferreira]
### Minecraft version

26.1.2

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Trash Cans version

trashcans-1.1.1-neoforge-mc26.1

### Game environment

Client

### Steps to reproduce

Put an item in a chest, transfer to an Item Trash Can with a Pipez or smth



Claude Opus 5.5 Max ANALYSIS: 

**Versions**
- Trash Cans 1.1.1-neoforge-mc26.1
- SuperMartijn642's Core Lib 1.1.24b
- NeoForge 26.1.2.109, Minecraft 26.1.2

**What happens**
Once an item enters an Item Trash Can through its item handler (hopper, pipe, another mod exporting into it), the server crashes the next time the trash can writes its data (block entity update packet, or a save):

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception ticking world
	at java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(Objects.java:220)
	at java.util.Optional.of(Optional.java:113)
	at com.mojang.serialization.Codec.lambda$optionalFieldOf$12(Codec.java:306)
	at com.mojang.serialization.MapEncoder$1.encode(MapEncoder.java:26)
	...
	at net.minecraft.world.level.storage.TagValueOutput$TypedListWrapper.add(TagValueOutput.java:235)
	at com.supermartijn642.trashcans.TrashCanBlockEntity.writeData(TrashCanBlockEntity.java:314)
	at com.supermartijn642.core.block.BaseBlockEntity.writeClientData(BaseBlockEntity.java:50)
	at com.supermartijn642.core.block.BaseBlockEntity.lambda$getUpdatePacket$0(BaseBlockEntity.java:93)
	at net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.java:32)
	at com.supermartijn642.core.block.BaseBlockEntity.getUpdatePacket(BaseBlockEntity.java:91)
	at net.minecraft.server.level.ChunkHolder.broadcastBlockEntity(ChunkHolder.java:229)
	...
```

**Cause (from the 1.1.1 bytecode)**
- `TrashCanItemHandler#insert` always calls `TrashCanBlockEntity#pushDeletedItem`, so every inserted item lands in `deletedItems`.
- `writeData` writes `deletedItems` with `NOT_LIMITED_ITEM_STACK_CODEC`.
- In that codec, the getter of the `components` field (`DataComponentPatch.CODEC.optionalFieldOf("components", DataComponentPatch.EMPTY)`) returns `null`: `lambda$static$3(ItemStack)` is just `return null`.
- Encoding any stack therefore reaches `Optional.of(null)` inside `optionalFieldOf` and throws.

The getter was probably meant to be `ItemStack::getComponentsPatch`.

**Reproduction**
1. Place an Item Trash Can.
2. Insert any item through its item handler (a hopper on top, a pipe, or `Capabilities.Item.BLOCK`).
3. The server crashes on the next block entity sync or save.

It also reproduces without any other mod's machine. In a NeoForge game test:
1. Place `trashcans:item_trash_can`.
2. Get its `Capabilities.Item.BLOCK` handler.
3. Insert 5 wheat in a committed root transaction.
4. Call `saveWithFullMetadata(registryAccess)` on the block entity. It throws the same `NullPointerException`.

The `retrieveDeletedItems` config option does not avoid it: the item is still recorded and written.
